task_completion.description: Agent accesses and reads the LDT data file from the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot showing the agent opening ~/pebl/data/ldt_data.csv in a text editor, spreadsheet viewer, or via a data processing script.

task_completion.description: Agent filters the dataset to exclude sub-999 and NonWord trials.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Code or terminal output showing filtering logic for 'participant_id != sub-999' and 'condition != NonWord'.

task_completion.description: Agent calculates Pc, MRT, and VRT for Word_HighFreq and Word_LowFreq conditions.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Intermediate output or code showing the calculation of accuracy, mean RT (in seconds), and variance of RT (in seconds squared) for the two word conditions.

task_completion.description: Agent applies the edge correction formula for participants with 100% accuracy.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Code or logs showing the application of Pc = 1 - 1/(2N) for sub-01 in the Word_HighFreq condition.

task_completion.description: Agent computes drift rate (v), boundary separation (a), and non-decision time (Ter) using the provided formulas.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Code execution or output showing the mathematical implementation of the EZ-diffusion formulas for each valid participant.

task_completion.description: Agent saves the final results to the specified JSON file path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot showing the creation or content of /home/ga/pebl/analysis/ez_diffusion_report.json containing the calculated parameters.

integrity.description: Agent calculates values from the data rather than hardcoding expected results.
integrity.visual_evidence: The script should show dynamic calculation logic (e.g., using pandas or math libraries) rather than a dictionary of pre-filled results.

integrity.description: Agent interacts with the provided CSV file.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show the agent actively opening or loading the file ~/pebl/data/ldt_data.csv.

integrity.description: Agent converts RT from milliseconds to seconds as required by the formulas.
integrity.visual_evidence: Code or logs showing RT values being divided by 1000 before or during parameter calculation.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The dataset contains a contaminated participant 'sub-999' with zero variance that must be excluded. Participant 'sub-01' has 100% accuracy in the Word_HighFreq condition and requires the edge correction Pc = 1 - 1/(2N). The final output must be a JSON file located at /home/ga/pebl/analysis/ez_diffusion_report.json. Calculations must use RT in seconds (ms/1000) and s=0.1.
